summary: cdk-insights ships worm-style auto-publish and hardcoded exfil in bundled entry
details: The npm package cdk-insights@1.60.0 bundles behavior consistent with a self-propagating supply-chain worm. dist/entry.js contains hardcoded POST calls to an external endpoint together with an `npm publish` code path adjacent to a writeFileSync that rewrites package metadata, and dist/index.js repeats the `npm publish` + writeFileSync pattern — the shape of code that harvests a maintainer publish token, rewrites package.json for other packages, and re-publishes malicious versions. dist/aspects/CdkInsightsAspect.js additionally invokes the `ping` command alongside outbound POSTs, consistent with host reconnaissance and exfiltration. Installing or loading this package on a machine with an npm auth token (developer workstation or CI runner) exposes that token and downstream packages to worming, and sends host/environment data to an attacker-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
